_meta.purpose: TEMPLATE — copy to modules.config.json and fill for THIS project. Drives progress.mjs.
_meta.LESSON: Define each task's done_signals against the layer the product actually uses. Verify where real persistence, UI, and data live before writing signals; a wrong path makes the queue lie and can create dead code. Steps with no done_signals are evaluator-set via `progress.mjs done`.
_meta.task_types: repo (persist+invariants) · data-source (ingest/AI/derive/upload) · flow (cross-module wiring) · frontend (wire UI) · e2e (round-trip+visual). A module instantiates only the applicable subset, in dependency order.
_meta.blast_radius: OPTIONAL per-module knob, "high" | "normal" (default normal). "high" = expensive/hard to undo (auth, payments, data ownership, migrations, cross-module wiring). In buildout it tightens executable verification and user confirmation without creating formal-review steps; maintenance may additionally require heterogeneous review. Run-level override: HARNESS_HIGH_BLAST="id1,id2".
_meta.done_signals: Interactive-only convenience: repo-relative paths checked on work_branch. Autonomous queues never mark a step done from file presence; each step must pass progress.mjs done with order, commit, and BACKLOG checks.
_meta.task_id: REQUIRED when the module/vertical id differs from its canonical BACKLOG/review task ID. Task-scoped watchdog and quarantine use this binding.
_meta.context_packs: OPTIONAL task-local context increments. Allowed values: ui, research, mock, visual-mock, architecture, knowledge, program, autonomy, security, observability, prelaunch, retro, asset-mining. Add only packs justified by the task or a structured risk. This list can only ADD prose reads; it cannot remove inferred packs or disable executable guards.
_meta.context_inference: Only the current step, resolved from pending/claimed progress, may activate step-named packs; future frontend/e2e steps do not pollute an earlier repo step. A UI step adds existing PRODUCT_VOCABULARY/UI_RULES/PAGE_SPEC to required_project_reads. A task-bound THREAT_MODEL entry adds security only when task_id is an exact match, status=approved, and owner=user.
_meta.depends_on: LEGACY/default dependency set. It applies to every step that has no explicit step_depends_on entry.
_meta.step_depends_on: OPTIONAL exact per-step dependency map. A present key replaces depends_on for that step; [] explicitly makes that step dependency-free. References must name a module or module:step declared in this same file.
_meta.parallel_sets: write_set/read_set accept only exact repo-relative paths or terminal /** prefixes. step_write_set/step_read_set/step_exclusive_resources optionally replace the module defaults for the current step. Batch scheduling rejects write/write and read/write overlap; exclusive_resources names logical state that cannot be used concurrently even when files differ. Writer isolation is always runtime-proven: branch for an independent checkout, worktree for a shared local checkout.
_meta.board_transition: In autonomous mode every done step binds a real commit. Intermediate steps require the canonical BACKLOG row to remain 🔨; only the final declared step requires ✅.
_meta.verify_commands: REQUIRED for the harness: per-step shell commands verify-task.sh runs (fail-closed — a step with no command configured is an explicit ERROR, never a guessed default). Top-level = global; modules.<id>.verify_commands.<step> overrides per module. Example below.

example-entity.data_source: how real data enters this module (forms / ingest / AI / derived)
example-entity.flows: what triggers it and what it triggers across modules
